title: botrychium virginianum var. typicum
intro: Botrychium virginianum var. typicum, commonly known as American Lady or Rusty Buttercup, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of American Lady fern include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds, reducing pain and inflammation, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of American Lady fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
